# OpenClaw Consulting

OpenClaw Consulting is a Swiss AI automation consulting service for SMEs, agencies and freelancers.

Website: https://openclaw-consulting.ch/
Language: German and English
Market: Switzerland
Contact: support@openclaw-consulting.ch
Related service: https://hosting.openclaw-consulting.ch/

## What we do

We design and implement practical AI automations for Swiss businesses, especially:

- email triage and reply drafting
- offer and document generation
- reporting and dashboard automation
- follow-up and reminder workflows
- internal knowledge assistants
- AI agents connected to existing business tools

The focus is not generic AI hype. The focus is measurable time savings in everyday business workflows.

## Typical customers

- Swiss SMEs
- freelancers and consultants
- small agencies
- service businesses with repetitive admin work
- teams using email, calendar, documents, CRM, spreadsheets or reporting tools heavily

## Delivery model

Typical projects start with one high-impact use case and a working prototype. Simple automations can usually go live in 2–4 weeks.

## Commercial model

Projects are scoped individually after an initial consultation. Simple automations typically start from CHF 1'500. Larger workflows are quoted as fixed projects or staged implementation packages.

## Data and trust

OpenClaw Consulting prefers privacy-conscious architectures, Swiss hosting where appropriate, and clear separation between business data, automation logic and AI providers. Customer data is not used for AI model training by OpenClaw Consulting.

## Relationship to OpenClaw

OpenClaw Consulting and OpenClaw Hosting are independent services built around the open-source OpenClaw ecosystem. The official OpenClaw project is available at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw and https://docs.openclaw.ai/.
